relationships.subject: acetaminophen
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results showed no significant differences in BBB permeability between vehicle control and acetaminophen treated groups

relationships.subject: acetaminophen
relationships.evidence_quote: We did also not observe significant changes in tight junction proteins in brain.

key_findings: Acetaminophen at 300 and 600 mg/kg did not change brain uptake clearance of sucrose in mice, indicating no acute BBB permeability change.
No significant changes in brain tight junction proteins; effects on BBB may be species-specific among rodents.
